request: Create a definition list for three keyboard shortcuts. Each shortcut is a term followed by a brief description.
solution:
<dl>
  <dt>Ctrl + S</dt>
  <dd>Save the current document.</dd>
  <dt>Ctrl + Z</dt>
  <dd>Undo the last change.</dd>
  <dt>Ctrl + F</dt>
  <dd>Find text in the current document.</dd>
</dl>

smokeCases.input: Expected terms: Ctrl + S, Ctrl + Z, Ctrl + F
smokeCases.expected: Each appears in a dt followed by its own dd.

request: Show upload progress for 3 of 8 files with a visible label and a machine-readable progress value.
solution:
<label for="upload-progress">Upload progress</label>
<progress id="upload-progress" value="3" max="8">3 of 8 files</progress>

smokeCases.expected: The progress element exposes those numeric attributes and has a label linked by id.
